replace.description: Replace the OpenStreetMap-derived data for this category (must be consistent across the category's entries; default false: supplement)

areas_of_interest.description: Optional areas of interest configuration. 'public_open_space' supplies custom area data (a mapping with a category-level 'replace' setting and a 'data_sources' list, a bare list of entries, or a single data entry). 'osm_open_space' is a distinct, optional entry overriding individual OpenStreetMap open space definitions for this region, so locally-relevant open space typologies can be captured without pre-processing custom data.

osm_open_space.description: Region-specific overrides of the open space definitions in configuration/osm_open_space.yml. Any definition not listed keeps its global default; a definition that is listed has its 'criteria' replaced outright (given directly as a string or list, or as a mapping containing a 'criteria' key so a whole block may be copied and edited). Valid definition names: additional_public_criteria, identifying_tags_to_exclude_other_than_name, linear_feature_criteria, os_add_as_tags, os_boundary, os_excluded_keys, os_excluded_values, os_inclusion, os_landuse, os_linear, os_required, os_water, os_water_sports, public_not_in. Derived criteria (public_space, exclusion_criteria) are recomposed from their sources and cannot be overridden. Has no effect where public_open_space is configured with 'replace: true'.

policy_review.description: Optional path to include policy indicator checklist in generated reports

routing_engine.description: Accessibility routing engine for the pedestrian neighbourhood analysis (nearest-POI distances and the neighbourhood density all-pairs search) and, unless overridden by cycling_indicators.routing_engine, the cycling analysis including its activity-centre walk-sheds: 'pgrouting' (default; batched pgr_drivingDistance in PostGIS, with networkx for the density search) or 'inmemory' (exact in-process Dijkstra; identical results, far faster on large cities and light on RAM).

cycling_indicators.description: Optional cycling Level of Traffic Stress (LTS) accessibility analysis.  Set to true to enable with defaults, or provide a mapping of options.

speed_limits.description: Speed limit assignment used for LTS classification.

defaults.description: Per-highway-type default speed limits (km/h), used where OSM maxspeed is missing.

defaults_csv.description: Path (under process/data) to a CSV with columns 'highway' and 'default_maxspeed' (alternative to 'defaults').

zones.description: Optional spatial speed overrides; edges matching a zone take the zone speed.

data.description: Path (under process/data) to a polygon or line dataset (geojson/gpkg).

buffer.description: Buffer (m) applied to line zone geometry before matching.

overlap_threshold.description: For method 'overlap': minimum share of the edge footprint within the zone (default 0.5).

edge_buffer.description: For method 'overlap': edge footprint width (m); default max(5, buffer/2).

apply_to.description: Override only edges with a missing OSM speed ('missing', default, the R behaviour) or every matched edge ('all').

no_cycle.description: Highway classes on which cycling is not permitted.

routing_engine.description: Accessibility routing engine for the cycling analysis: 'pgrouting' (default; banded pgr_drivingDistance in PostGIS) or 'inmemory' (exact in-process Dijkstra per destination spec; equivalent results, far faster on large cities and light on RAM).  When unset, falls back to the region's top-level routing_engine.

distances.description: Cycling catchment thresholds in metres, e.g. [2000, 5000].

contrasts.description: Ordered pairs of accessibility measures calculated and juxtaposed in the validation report (the first pair is the headline contrast; later pairs render below it as alternative contrasts for each reporting item).  Measures: 'lts1' (fully LTS 1 routes, geometric distance), 'low_stress' (fully LTS 1-2 routes, geometric distance; the established headline), 'low_stress_ride' (as low_stress but ridden throughout, excluding links the rider would have to dismount and walk), 'danger_weighted' (all streets routable, higher-stress length penalised).  Every measure named in a contrast is calculated.  Pairing 'low_stress_ride' with 'low_stress' additionally derives the dismount-dependence (dmgap_) indicators.  Default: [[low_stress, danger_weighted]].

measures.description: Optional extra accessibility measures to calculate beyond those named in contrasts.

dismount_priority.description: Rank the individual links riders must dismount and walk ('foot_dismount') by the population whose nearest-destination low-stress route passes over them, and by the population that would lose access entirely without them - candidate locations for cycling infrastructure, written to the cycling_dismount_priority table.  Derived from the shortest-path trees the routing already builds, so it adds no routing time.  Requires routing_engine 'inmemory' and both measures of the [low_stress_ride, low_stress] pair.

destinations.description: Destination specs to analyse; each maps a layer (optionally SQL-filtered) to an indicator name, tagged by category and strictness variant for the composite indicators.

name.description: Indicator name, used in output column names.

layer.description: PostGIS destination layer (must have nearest-node associations).

where.description: Optional SQL filter on the layer, e.g. "dest_name = 'fresh_food_market'" or 'headway <= 20'.

category.description: Destination category (e.g. food, pos, pt) grouping its variants.

variant.description: Strictness variant (e.g. strict, lenient); composite 'all categories' indicators are derived per variant.

activity_centres.description: Activity-centre (destination cluster) indicator. A centre is a network node whose pedestrian walk-shed reaches one of every required category; cycling safe-route access is measured to the nearest centre per tier. Set false to disable; true (default) uses the options below. May also be a map of named definitions (e.g. a 'local_custom' definition adding a locally-relevant category); a 'standard' definition is always included.

walk_threshold.description: Pedestrian co-location radius in metres (default 400, ~5 min walk).

categories.description: Destination categories that must co-locate (default [food, pos, pt]).

tiers.description: Map of tier name to the destination variant it is built from (default {local: lenient, complete: strict}).

combined_access.description: Named 'all categories reachable' composite indicator sets; each lists the categories to combine, evaluated across the strict and lenient variants. A 'standard' set over the global categories is always included (keeping comparable all_strict / all_lenient names); add e.g. a 'local_custom' set to also include a locally-relevant category (-> all_local_custom_strict / _lenient).

categories.description: Destination categories combined in this set.
